specs.title: unmuted autoplay blocked (simulated policy) → muted fallback; explicit fallback off → waits for gesture
Player Lab: load presets, inspect state, simulate faults, download diagnostics, reset
Player Lab Phase 2 panels: embed code, iframe preview, command console, analytics consent
analytics: off by default, consent-gated, batches reach ingest, no tokens, session_end by beacon
plugins: an engine fills the ads controller; impressions are deduplicated in analytics
commands: viewer/host/operator permissions, signed announcement shown, overlays unavailable
controllers expose the documented surface
trusted cross-origin host controls the iframe player via protocol v1
untrusted origin cannot read or control the iframe player
several embeds on one page stay isolated by channel
embed page refuses invalid configuration with a readable message
the Player Lab cannot be framed by another origin; the embed page can
React wrapper: StrictMode-safe lifecycle, prop updates without re-creation, clean unmount
MP4: plays from initial load, captions selectable
HLS VOD (MPEG-TS, 3 renditions): plays, reports duration and resolution
HLS VOD (fMP4/CMAF): plays
VOD seeking: seekTo, clamping, repeated play/pause/seek stays consistent
HLS Live (MPEG-TS): plays, detected as live, latency reported
HLS Live (fMP4/CMAF): plays, detected as live, latency reported
HLS Live: plays across a playlist loop discontinuity
HLS Live: pausing drifts behind live; Go Live returns to the edge
source switching: MP4 → HLS VOD → Live → MP4 lands on the last source
source switching: rapid replacement while loading never shows a stale source
multiple isolated player instances on one page
error recovery: transient 503s at start are retried and playback starts
error recovery: segment outage mid-VOD → recovering → resumes near the same position
live-edge recovery: segment outage on a live stream recovers back at the live edge
approved fallback source plays when the primary is missing
error message: missing file → MISSING_FILE
error message: invalid manifest → INVALID_MANIFEST
error message: unsupported format → UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT
error message: forbidden → FORBIDDEN
error message: server error (retried, then fatal) → SERVER
error message: javascript: URL → INVALID_SOURCE
error message: expired signed URL → EXPIRED_URL; fresh signature plays
retry button after a fatal error reloads the source
keyboard: play/pause, seek, volume, mute, captions — only when the player has focus
controls are keyboard reachable and every control has an accessible name
fullscreen and theater toggles; layout adapts to a mobile viewport
touch: double-tap right side seeks forward; vertical swipe is left to the page
muted autoplay: autoplay "muted" starts without a gesture
cleanup: repeated create/destroy leaves no players, DOM, listeners or heap growth
destroy during load and during playback is safe
wrapping an existing <video> restores it on destroy
config validation rejects unsafe values before touching the page
